headline: BUA Cement Nine-Month Pre-Tax Profit Rises 64% as Revenue Tops N1 Trillion
summary: BUA Cement Plc reported a 64.43% surge in pre-tax profit to N556.70 billion for the nine months ended September 30, up from N338.57 billion a year earlier, with revenue surpassing N1 trillion.
why: BUA Cement is one of Nigeria's largest industrial producers; its earnings reflect domestic construction activity and infrastructure expenditure in Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: BUA Cement Plc
impacts.why: Pre-tax profit climbed 64.43% while revenue topped N1 trillion in the nine-month period.
